summary: Chamath notes Rick's Cabaret stock has dropped ~25-30% recently and historically has presaged recessions, suggesting the move signals an upcoming economic downturn.

summary: Friedberg argues Rick's Cabaret revenue decline is structural, driven by OnlyFans pulling top talent out of physical venues, reducing product quality and foot traffic — not merely a recession signal.
